imageRequirements.bobo: only the canonical 1.0.0 Bobo when the individual draft calls for it

audioRequirements.word: one clear standard-German pronunciation of the lemma or expression
audioRequirements.sentence: one clear standard-German pronunciation of the practical example

productionSafeguards: No provider request until the item passes linguistic review.
No paid provider is enabled without an owner-approved cost and account step.
No asset is attached to a card before visual or audio QA passes.
No card is published before PWA and mobile flow validation.
